system.description:
A little time at the range goes a long way. You know how to hold, fire, clean and unjam a gun, tell models apart, and handle recoil and field problems.

If you possess Firearms, you may use your Mental Traits instead of Physical Traits for gun combat at no cost, and you can expend Firearms for a retest in ranged-fire combat.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
